classification.difficultyReason: Model the reduced base dimensions, solve a quadratic and reject a root that gives impossible dimensions.

content.prompt: A sheet of cardboard 24 cm long and 17 cm wide has squares of side length $x$ cm cut from each corner so that it can be folded to form an open box with base area of $228\text{ cm}^2$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Express the length and width of the base in terms of $x$.

answer.worked: Two squares of side length $x$ are removed along each original dimension. The base therefore has length $(24-2x)$ cm and width $(17-2x)$ cm.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Write an expression involving $x$ and solve it for $x$.

answer.short:
$x=2.5$.

Use the base area to form a quadratic and reject the root that gives negative base dimensions.
answer.worked:
Using the base area,
$$\begin{align*}(24-2x)(17-2x)&=228\\4x^2-82x+408&=228\\4x^2-82x+180&=0\\2x^2-41x+90&=0\\(2x-5)(x-18)&=0\\x&=\frac52\text{ or }18\end{align*}$$
A box requires $0<x<8.5$. Reject $x=18$, which gives negative base dimensions. Hence $x=2.5$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the dimensions of the box.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Length}&=24-2(2.5)=19\text{ cm}\\\text{Width}&=17-2(2.5)=12\text{ cm}\\\text{Height}&=2.5\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
The box is 19 cm long, 12 cm wide and 2.5 cm high.
